APPROVE
The three extracted helpers keep the same order of filtering, the same first-resolution-wins `TryAdd` and the same `from \`` exclusion, so behaviour is unchanged and the nested branches no longer count against `ParsePodfileLock`; I reviewed only the diff and did not build the project or recompute the complexity score, so both assume no unseen `entry`/`name` clash elsewhere in the loop body and that `resolved` is a `Dictionary<string, string>`.
